    Zip QC'd .csv files for transfer to AODN

    Source: R/push_2_aodn.R
    push_2_aodn.Rd

    Zips the QC'd .csv files of each campaign into <cid><suffix>.zip in path, then deletes the .csv files. The zip files are transferred to AODN by sftp outside this function.

    push_2_aodn(
  cids,
  path = NULL,
  user = NULL,
  host = NULL,
  dest = NULL,
  pwd = NULL,
  nopush = TRUE,
  suffix = "_nrt"
)

    Arguments

    cids

    campaign ids to zip

    path

    path to the QC'd .csv files

    user

    no longer used (formerly the rsync username); ignored

    host

    no longer used (formerly the rsync server); ignored

    dest

    no longer used (formerly the rsync destination); ignored

    pwd

    no longer used (formerly the rsync password); ignored

    nopush

    must be TRUE; transfer to AODN is done by sftp outside this function

    suffix

    suffix to add to zip files (_nrt or _dm)
